title: M$^2$RNN: Non-Linear RNNs with Matrix-Valued States for Scalable Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2603.14360v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformers are highly parallel but are limited to computations in the TC$^0$ complexity class, excluding tasks such as entity tracking and code execution that provably require greater expressive power. Motivated by this limitation, we revisit non-linear Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for language modeling and introduce Matrix-to-Matrix RNN (M$^2$RNN): an architecture with matrix-valued hidden states and expressive non-linear state transitions. We demonstrate that the language modeling performance of non-linear RNNs is limited by their state size, and show how the state size expansion mechanism enables efficient use of tensor cores. Empirically, M$^2$RNN achieves perfect state tracking generalization at sequence lengths not seen during training. These benefits also translate to large-scale language modeling. In hybrid settings that interleave recurrent layers with attention, Hybrid M$^2$RNN outperforms equivalent Gated Delta

translated_title: M$^2$RNN：基于矩阵值状态的非线性循环神经网络用于可扩展的语言建模
translated_abstract: Transformer具有高度并行性，但其计算能力局限于TC$^0$复杂度类，无法完成诸如实体跟踪和代码执行等已被证明需要更强表达能力的任务。受此限制的启发，我们重新审视非线性循环神经网络（RNN）在语言建模中的应用，并提出了矩阵到矩阵RNN（M$^2$RNN）：一种具有矩阵值隐藏状态和富有表达力的非线性状态转移的架构。我们证明了非线性RNN的语言建模性能受其状态规模的限制，并展示了状态规模扩展机制如何实现对张量核心的高效利用。实验表明，M$^2$RNN在训练中未见过的序列长度上实现了完美的状态跟踪泛化。这些优势同样体现在大规模语言建模中。在将循环层与注意力机制交错组合的混合设置中，混合M$^2$RNN优于等效的门控Delta（Gated Delta）……
tldr: 提出了一种具有矩阵值隐藏状态和非线性状态转移的新型循环神经网络M$^2$RNN，突破了Transformer在TC$^0$复杂度上的表达能力限制，实现了完美状态跟踪泛化并在大规模语言建模中表现优异。
en_tdlr: M$^2$RNN introduces non-linear RNNs with matrix-valued hidden states that overcome the TC$^0$ expressiveness limitation of Transformers, achieving perfect state tracking generalization and strong large-scale language modeling performance.
